rewrites._comment: Proxies the API through this origin so the browser never makes a cross-origin request. Hugging Face's router intercepts CORS preflights and answers them without Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, which blocks every credentialed request that carries a JSON body - login and register included. Same-origin requests require no preflight, so this sidesteps the interception entirely. Requires VITE_API_URL=/api. Must precede the SPA fallback.
SPA fallback. Excludes /api/ so the proxy rule above is not shadowed.
